CORRECTION to the result I first recorded, which said Failed and proposed a ticket. That was wrong.
This case asks that typing a record number in full pins that record on its own above the groups. It does not — the record comes back inside its group. But you already ruled on exactly this behaviour on 29 September, on two older checks that test the same thing: “This feature has been taken off.” You marked both of those as passing yourself.

146301.why:
This case is held by its own Expected Results: the specification sets a pause before searching but no minimum number of letters, so what one letter should do has never been decided. It says in terms “do not pass or fail it”.
What I saw anyway: one letter and two letters both bring back a normal list. Nothing breaks, nothing hangs, and the second letter replaces the first letter’s results rather than leaving them on screen — which are the three things its Expected does commit to.
What would settle it: a decision on what a one or two letter search should do.
